thread_messages:
Marie: FYI vendor pushed the H200 shipment +10 days. They can air-topoff 6 units now, remaining 24 delayed. Need decision on accepting partial, realloc plans, and RMA/dock fee ask. @Jordan @Alex
Jordan: can you paste the vendor note? any change to unit pricing or DOA policy?
Marie: vendor note:
```
ETA update: Vessel delay -> arrival 2024-08-26. Air option: 6 units by 2024-08-16 (expedite fee applies). Pricing unchanged. RMA: returns accepted within 30 days, standard freight applies unless waived.
```
Jordan: ok pricing same is good. we should push for waive on RMA freight and dock fees given delay. Ask for consolidated AWB for replacements/returns.
Alex: Ops perspective: with 6 units we cover immediate SFO+DCA queue for ~48hrs but APAC remains starved. Rebalancing request: move 4 of the 6 to APAC edge once received. We can cold-migrate workloads, but latency-sensitive customers will notice.
Sam: +1 rebalance. Also need serials before handoff so we can pre-provision node configs. If vendor can provide serialized manifest ahead of arrival, depot can pre-stage. Without that we'll hit depot triage delays (~1 business day).
Marie: noted. I'll ask vendor for serialized manifest and consolidated AWB and request full waiver of dock fee for delayed units.
Vendor Ops: We can ask vendor: offering 2% credit on total invoice if you accept the air-topoff + commit to a second order. We will request dock waiver but cannot promise. Serialized manifest can be shared 48hrs before shipment.
Jordan: ask vendor to add written commitment for dock waiver or else we push for the 2% credit + waive expedite fee. Also request RMA express labels for any DOA replacements — we cannot absorb return freight cost.
Marie: draft message to vendor ready, sending now:
"Hi — thanks for ETA update. We will accept the 6-unit air-topoff conditional on: 1) consolidated AWB for both air and sea shipments, 2) serialized manifest shared 48hrs prior, 3) waiver of depot/dock fees for delayed units or equivalent invoice credit, 4) prepaid RMA labels for DOA returns. Please confirm in writing"
Alex: :thumbsup: once vendor confirms we schedule rebalancing plan. Sam and I will create temporary routing L2 runbook for moving 4 units to APAC and pre-provision images.
Sam: note: if vendor refuses dock waiver, we need a cost calc for absorbing vs. delaying acceptance. I can compute quick TCO (freight + lost capacity) in next hour.
RMA-Bot: New RMA playbook draft created: `rma-playbooks/air-topoff-fast-track.md` — includes label templates and manifest checklist.
Marie: thanks RMA-Bot. I'll attach playbook to vendor reply thread.
Jordan: sounds good. keep this thread for vendor confirmation and next steps. If vendor accepts credit instead of waiver, capture amounts and update finance.
Marie: pinging vendor now. Will update when they respond.
Vendor Ops: vendor replied: "We can share serialized manifest 48hrs prior and will escalate dock waiver internally; can offer 1.5% invoice credit if waiver not granted."
Jordan: capture that offer and push for full waiver. I'll loop finance if they hold at 1.5%.
Marie: copying finance and ops. End of thread for now — updates as they come.
